newsitem.title: TURKEY: 15 dead in Turkey's Kurdish conflict.
newsitem.headline: 15 dead in Turkey's Kurdish conflict.

text.p: Turkish security forces killed 14 Kurdish rebels and one soldier died in a clash in eastern Turkey, state-run Anatolian news agency said on Thursday.
The fighting took place in the eastern province of Erzincan, it said. It was not clear when the clash occurred.
More than 24,000 people have died in the 12-year conflict between Turkish troops and Kurdistan Workers Party guerrillas fighting for self-rule in the mainly Kurdish southeast of the country.
More than 10,000 Turkish troops have been engaged in a three-week cross-border operation against rebel bases in the mountains of northern Iraq.
